text:
joel: Heads up — in the latest deploy the dashboard's compact grid mode looks cramped when the left rail is collapsed. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/grid-compact-collapsed.png
maria: I noticed that too. Did someone change the spacing token set for condensed surfaces? Feels like card headers are hugging the body now.
ranjit: I adjusted --token-gap-compact from 8px -> 4px to squeeze more columns for analytics. it helped layout density but maybe too aggressive.
kaya: 4px is below our touch-target guidance. on mobile the card action buttons are basically shoulder-to-shoulder. :grimacing:
joel: Accessibility callout — keyboard focus outline clips into the divider in that state. users with high-contrast themes can't tell which row is focused.
maria: Could we separate visual spacing from interactive padding? e.g. keep visual gap small but add invisible interaction padding via .card-action::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -6px; } so layout doesn't shift.
ranjit: That's feasible but messy across components. Also pseudo-element approach interferes with overflow:hidden in some cards.
kaya: Alternative: revert compact gap to 6px and reduce header top/bottom padding by 2px. preserves grid density and fixes hit targets. less hacky.
joel: I like the revert + header pad tweak. Also propose outline-offset: 3px on focus to avoid clipping dividers. simple CSS change.
maria: Agree. small token delta is easier to audit. I'll prepare a patch: --token-gap-compact 4px -> 6px, --card-header-pt 12px -> 10px, add focus outline-offset.
ranjit: One more: toast UX. We currently show success toast for saves for 4.5s; users doing quick edits get a backlog. Suggest default 2.5s, errors remain sticky with manual dismissal.
kaya: 2.5s feels snappy. Maybe keep warning to 4s. Also set max-visible-toasts to 3 to avoid pileup.
joel: Copy nit while reviewing QA notes: the action button on mini-cards says "Open" — ambiguous. prefer "Open details" for clarity and screen reader context.
maria: I'll include copy update in same change. Also will add aria-label="Open details for {itemName}" on the button.
aria-bot: Note: update design-tokens.md and components/a11y-checklist.md after landing.
joel: Plan: patch today, run visual diffs and accessibility smoke tomorrow. assign ranjit for runtime check. Thanks team :rocket:
